Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building ages, sizes, classrooms, specialized spaces, and detailed site plans (e.g., Foothill ES, p.15-22). Robust condition assessments cover major systems (HVAC, roofing, electrical, plumbing) with deferred maintenance and lifecycle planning integrated (e.g., Foothill ES, p.15-30).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections over 5-10 years with methodology explained, including demographic and housing data (e.g., p.291-305). Capacity utilization data by site and classroom type is linked to specific facility actions such as portable replacements and new construction (e.g., Foothill ES, p.16-19; Los Medanos ES, p.66-73).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle, with detailed educational specifications for all school types (elementary, junior high, high school) covering classrooms, specialized spaces, and support areas (e.g., Sections 5.1, p.315-385). Facility projects are directly connected to educational goals and program needs (e.g., STEM labs, CTE, special education).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Plans include data and analysis of outdoor spaces with strategies for improvements such as shade structures, landscaping, and outdoor classrooms at multiple sites (e.g., Foothill ES, p.15-30; Marina Vista ES, p.81-90). However, districtwide greening and climate resilience framing is limited.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related issues such as shade for heat mitigation and stormwater drainage improvements (e.g., Foothill ES, p.15-30; Marina Vista ES, p.81-90). However, lacks comprehensive district-wide climate risk assessment or integrated resilience strategies.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency measures such as photovoltaic arrays at multiple sites, HVAC upgrades, and references to Title 24 and Zero Net Energy goals (e.g., Foothill ES, p.15-30; Marina Vista ES, p.81-90). Energy resilience is mentioned but lacks comprehensive district-wide strategy.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed cost estimates with escalation assumptions across all projects and sites (e.g., p.373-390). Includes clear prioritization frameworks and multiple funding strategies including state grants, bonds, and local measures. Aligns financial capacity with educational and facility needs.
